page.overview:
What is Shooting Star?

The Shooting Star was a starship piloted by the male Twi'lek Remmik Kulavinar. In 44 ABY, Kulavinar piloted reporter Madhi Vaandt and her news crew in the Shooting Star while she was doing a segment on existing slavery practices throughout the galaxy for The Perre Needmo Newshour.
